en.title: 4. Event Schedule & Rundown
en.excerpt: How to schedule daily championship rundowns, practice sessions, qualification waves, and elimination medal matches.
en.content:
Timeline Architecture & Day Sessions

A well-organized schedule is the backbone of any archery tournament. In Archeris, event schedules are managed through the Schedule module, allowing organizers to divide multi-day championships into clear, timestamped sessions.

Configuring Daily Rundowns

To set up daily event rundowns:

  1. Open your event in Organizer Dashboard > Schedule.
  2. Click + Add Schedule Item.
  3. Define the session attributes:
    • Session Date: Specific calendar day (e.g., Day 1: Official Practice, Day 2: Recurve Qualification, Day 3: Elimination & Finals).
    • Start & End Time: The exact timeframe (e.g., 08:00 to 11:30 WIB).
    • Activity Title: Clear operational title (e.g., Qualification Round: Recurve Men & Women 70m).
    • Assigned Categories: Tag which competition divisions participate in this session.
  4. Click Save Schedule to store the timeline.

Time Validation & Wave Coordination

To prevent scheduling conflicts and confusing overlaps, Archeris incorporates automated time validation:

  • End Time Check: The end time must always be greater than the start time.
  • Wave Intervals: We recommend allocating a 15-minute buffer between qualification sessions to allow archers to change target faces and calibrate electronic scoreboards.
  • Local Timezone Synchronization: All timestamps automatically format according to the tournament venue's local timezone (WIB / WITA / WIT / UTC+7).

Public Schedule Visibility

Published schedule items appear in real time on the public tournament landing page, athlete e-tickets, and live score screens, allowing archers and coaches to monitor when their specific wave begins shooting.
